== Summary ==
Slip “•No Disintegrations!” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 839, 581, 1124)). Version [[No Disintegrations! (V)#Source formats|No Disintegrations! (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
